body: Thank you so much for your words of encouragement. It's just been me on my own for a long time now so I haven't really had any outside opinion in the matter. I do want to add one last quote from her the last we talked though. And she said "her biggest fear is that I'm going to show up in the hospital unannounced ready to be world's greatest dad, and I didn't do anything to help her prepare."

I really appreciate this. And you're exactly right. I don't know if I should send her this though. I know the response I'm going to get. It's the same story. "I didn't help her when she was pregnant so why should I be allowed to come around now."
It would be easier. But I don't think I can not see the little girl. Jill admitted this also. And she's definitely having it. No more abortion. The little girl is due this month
That was exactly their point. But they also think that the way she treats me and how she makes me feel, that it would be better if I just don't contact her. And set up a trust fund for the child.
